'''Nigel III''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] situated along the [[Enarc Run/Legends|Enarc Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]].  It had an Imperial presence during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The world's [[Port Authority|port authority]] seized the [[Kazellis-class light freighter]] ''[[Longrunner]]'' after it arrested the [[freighter]]'s [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Duan Zorn]], for failing to pay docking fees.

==Description==
Nigel III was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and land suitable for hiking. Nigel III,<ref name="Stock Ships" /> along with another terrestrial planet, [[Nigel VI]],<ref name="Twin Stars of Kira">{{WEGCite|story=The Package (adventure)|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref> were both located in the [[Nigel system/Legends|Nigel system]] within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]]. The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was situated in the [[Kira sector/Legends|Kira sector]] along the [[Enarc Run/Legends|Enarc Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==History==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained a presence on Nigel III. [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] [[Lynx Reglis]] was stationed on the planet, where she enjoyed several recreational activities, including taking ocean cruises and going on nature hikes. The planet's [[Port Authority|port authority]] arrested [[Duan Zorn]]&mdash;a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Free-trader|freetrader]]&mdash;for failing to pay docking fees for the ''[[Longrunner]]'', his [[Kazellis-class light freighter]]. Afterwards, the authorities seized the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] when they discovered that Zorn had stolen the [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Later, [[Dav Kathis]], a former [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Naval]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]], purchased the ''Longrunner'' after the Imperial [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] on Nigel III put it up for auction.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

==Inhabitants==
Starship traffic on the planet was monitored by its port authority, which could impound ships that failed to pay tariffs or docking fees. The Galactic Empire had a number of personnel stationed on the planet including Reglis, one of its officers.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nigel III was introduced in ''[[Stock Ships]]'', a [[1997]] supplement to the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[West End Games]].<ref name="Stock Ships" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], placed the Nigel system, and thereby Nigel III, in grid square N-15.<ref name="Atlas" /> The grid square was updated to N-16 in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book.<ref name="Appendix" /> Both works place the Nigel system in the Expansion Region;<ref name="Appendix" /><ref name="Atlas" /> however, the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] maps in ''The Essential Atlas'' also erroneously place the system in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Atlas" />
